# Link row

Title link with url line, chips, and an actions cluster; hover state on the row.

Category: content · Behavior: none · Schema: 2.0.0 · Source: original

Static markup; no JavaScript required.

## Variants

No variant table; the item has a single form.

## Slots

Named `[data-uifa-slot]` render positions; the root is the implicit default slot.

- `title` - Row title link.
- `url` - URL line under the title.
- `chips` - Chip cluster.
- `chip` - Single metadata chip.
- `actions` - Action cluster at the row end.

## Tokens

Reads: `--uifa-accent`, `--uifa-accent-soft`, `--uifa-border`, `--uifa-border-strong`, `--uifa-border-width`, `--uifa-text`, `--uifa-text-muted`, `--uifa-radius-control`, `--uifa-font-body`, `--uifa-text-base`, `--uifa-space`, `--uifa-duration`, `--uifa-ease`. Every color comes from a semantic role; nothing is hard-coded.

## Markup

```html
<!-- Grid row: title link + url on line one, chips + actions below. -->
<div class="uifa-link-row">
  <a data-uifa-slot="title" href="https://example.com">Title of the link</a>
  <span data-uifa-slot="url">example.com</span>
  <div data-uifa-slot="chips">
    <span data-uifa-slot="chip">tag</span>
  </div>
  <div data-uifa-slot="actions">
    <a href="https://example.com">Open</a>
  </div>
</div>
```

## Usage

Use for lists of destinations: search results, recent files, reading queues. Parts: `[data-uifa-slot="title"]` (the link), `url`, `chips` (contains `[data-uifa-slot="chip"]` spans), `actions`. Hovering anywhere in the row underlines the title.
